<!-- Where the data and code are, and how the analysis is re-run. The DOI
     below is a placeholder: deposit_zenodo() reserves the real one and
     writes it here. A double-blind submission moves this section to the
     title page, and make_submission() also writes a copy of the compendium
     with no author in it, for the reviewers. -->

The data are the `BCI` dataset of the R package vegan [@R-vegan], collected
by @Condit2002. Data and code are archived at Zenodo
(doi:10.5281/zenodo.XXXXXXX). The analysis environment is recorded in
`renv.lock` and can be restored with renv [@R-renv]; the project structure
was generated with easypaper [@R-easypaper].
